name: merkle_membership
description: Proves a private leaf is included in a public Poseidon-2 Merkle tree of depth 8 without revealing the leaf or its path
useCases: Prove an address is on an allowlist without revealing which entry
Anonymous group membership checks against a published Merkle root

leaf.description: The secret leaf whose inclusion is being proven

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes along the path from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = leaf is left child, 1 = leaf is right child), bottom-up

root.description: Public Merkle root the leaf claims membership in
